spec.title: X-axis strategies test (Mobin Gold)
spec.description: Compare five x-axis strategies for multi-session charts. Only return-vs-index, excess, and portfolio value. Select multiple sessions to see differences.

spec.__legacyStringValue: SELECT name AS __text, name AS __value FROM pair_trade.strategy ORDER BY name;

SELECT s.id::text || ' @ ' || to_char(s.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS __text, s.id AS __value FROM pair_trade.session s JOIN pair_trade.strategy st ON st.id = s.strategy_id WHERE st.name = '$strategy' ORDER BY s.started_at DESC;

spec.title: 1. Real time — Portfolio return vs benchmark indexes (%)
spec.description: Wall-clock ts. Honest labels; overnight/weekend gaps visible.  Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded).

spec.rawSql:
WITH 

anchor AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
  ORDER BY s.started_at
  LIMIT 1
),
prev_session AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  JOIN anchor a ON s.strategy_id = a.strategy_id AND s.started_at < a.started_at
  ORDER BY s.started_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
nav0 AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session)
     ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
     ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
  ) AS v
),
base_marks AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id = (SELECT session_id FROM prev_session)
     ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
     WHERE p.session_id IN ($session) AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
     ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
  ) AS marks
),
m0 AS (
  SELECT split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) AS asset, kv.value::numeric AS m0
  FROM base_marks b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(b.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  WHERE kv.value::numeric > 0
),
sess_ord AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at) - 1 AS sess_ord
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
),
raw AS (
  SELECT p.session_id,
         p.ts AS real_ts,
         100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(n.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) IN ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'IRTKLOTF0001', 'IRTKROBA0001', 'IRTKGANJ0001', 'IRTKZARA0001')) AS top5_pct
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
  CROSS JOIN nav0 n
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  JOIN m0 m ON m.asset = split_part(kv.key, '-', 1)
  WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
    AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
    AND kv.value::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p.session_id, p.ts, p.portfolio_value, n.v
)
SELECT raw.real_ts AS time,
       raw.port_pct AS "Portfolio %",
       raw.all_pct AS "All index %",
       raw.top5_pct AS "Top5 index %",
       raw.port_pct - raw.all_pct AS "Excess vs All %",
       raw.port_pct - raw.top5_pct AS "Excess vs Top5 %"
FROM raw
JOIN sess_ord so ON so.session_id = raw.session_id
ORDER BY 1;

  SELECT sp.session_id,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.prev_id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.session_id AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
            ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
         ) AS marks
  FROM sess_prev sp
),
m0 AS (
  SELECT sm.session_id, split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) AS asset, kv.value::numeric AS m0
  FROM sess_marks0 sm
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sm.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  WHERE kv.value::numeric > 0
),
raw AS (
  SELECT p.session_id,
         p.ts AS real_ts,
         100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(n.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) IN ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'IRTKLOTF0001', 'IRTKROBA0001', 'IRTKGANJ0001', 'IRTKZARA0001')) AS top5_pct
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
  JOIN sess_nav0 n ON n.session_id = p.session_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  JOIN m0 m ON m.session_id = p.session_id AND m.asset = split_part(kv.key, '-', 1)
  WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
    AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
    AND kv.value::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p.session_id, p.ts, p.portfolio_value, n.v
),
sess_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.session_id)
         r.session_id, r.port_pct, r.all_pct, r.top5_pct,
         r.port_pct - r.all_pct AS xs_all,
         r.port_pct - r.top5_pct AS xs_top5
  FROM raw r
  ORDER BY r.session_id, r.real_ts DESC
),
-- Offset for session k = sum of end-% of all earlier selected sessions (cumulative).
sess_off AS (
  SELECT so.session_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.port_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS port_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.all_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.top5_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS top5_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_all) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_top5) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_top5_off
  FROM sess_ord so
  JOIN sess_end e ON e.session_id = so.session_id
)
SELECT r.real_ts AS time,
       r.port_pct + o.port_off AS "Portfolio %",
       r.all_pct + o.all_off AS "All index %",
       r.top5_pct + o.top5_off AS "Top5 index %",
       (r.port_pct - r.all_pct) + o.xs_all_off AS "Excess vs All %",
       (r.port_pct - r.top5_pct) + o.xs_top5_off AS "Excess vs Top5 %"
FROM raw r
JOIN sess_off o ON o.session_id = r.session_id
ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: 6. Cumulative across sessions — Portfolio excess return vs indexes (%)
spec.description: All selected sessions on real wall-clock. Each day’s path is shifted by the sum of earlier sessions’ end port/index/excess % (vs each session’s own prior close), so the series is a continuous additive cumulative from the first selected session. Excess = port − index (same baseline as return panel). Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded).

spec.rawSql:
WITH 
sess_ord AS (
  SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.started_at, s.strategy_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.started_at) - 1 AS sess_ord
  FROM pair_trade.session s
  WHERE s.id IN ($session)
),
sess_prev AS (
  SELECT so.session_id, so.sess_ord,
         (
           SELECT s2.id FROM pair_trade.session s2
           WHERE s2.strategy_id = so.strategy_id AND s2.started_at < so.started_at
           ORDER BY s2.started_at DESC LIMIT 1
         ) AS prev_id
  FROM sess_ord so
),
sess_nav0 AS (
  SELECT sp.session_id,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.prev_id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT p.portfolio_value FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.session_id AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
            ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
         ) AS v
  FROM sess_prev sp
),
sess_marks0 AS (
  SELECT sp.session_id,
         COALESCE(
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.prev_id ORDER BY p.ts DESC LIMIT 1),
           (SELECT p.marks FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
            WHERE p.session_id = sp.session_id AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
            ORDER BY p.ts ASC LIMIT 1)
         ) AS marks
  FROM sess_prev sp
),
m0 AS (
  SELECT sm.session_id, split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) AS asset, kv.value::numeric AS m0
  FROM sess_marks0 sm
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(sm.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  WHERE kv.value::numeric > 0
),
raw AS (
  SELECT p.session_id,
         p.ts AS real_ts,
         100.0 * (p.portfolio_value / NULLIF(n.v, 0) - 1) AS port_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1)) AS all_pct,
         AVG(100.0 * (kv.value::numeric / NULLIF(m.m0, 0) - 1))
           FILTER (WHERE split_part(kv.key, '-', 1) IN ('IRTKMOFD0001', 'IRTKLOTF0001', 'IRTKROBA0001', 'IRTKGANJ0001', 'IRTKZARA0001')) AS top5_pct
  FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
  JOIN sess_nav0 n ON n.session_id = p.session_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(p.marks) AS kv(key, value)
  JOIN m0 m ON m.session_id = p.session_id AND m.asset = split_part(kv.key, '-', 1)
  WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
    AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
    AND kv.value::numeric > 0
  GROUP BY p.session_id, p.ts, p.portfolio_value, n.v
),
sess_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.session_id)
         r.session_id, r.port_pct, r.all_pct, r.top5_pct,
         r.port_pct - r.all_pct AS xs_all,
         r.port_pct - r.top5_pct AS xs_top5
  FROM raw r
  ORDER BY r.session_id, r.real_ts DESC
),
-- Offset for session k = sum of end-% of all earlier selected sessions (cumulative).
sess_off AS (
  SELECT so.session_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.port_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS port_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.all_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.top5_pct) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS top5_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_all) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_all_off,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.xs_top5) OVER (
           ORDER BY so.sess_ord ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS xs_top5_off
  FROM sess_ord so
  JOIN sess_end e ON e.session_id = so.session_id
)
SELECT r.real_ts AS time,
       r.port_pct + o.port_off AS "Portfolio %",
       r.all_pct + o.all_off AS "All index %",
       r.top5_pct + o.top5_off AS "Top5 index %",
       (r.port_pct - r.all_pct) + o.xs_all_off AS "Excess vs All %",
       (r.port_pct - r.top5_pct) + o.xs_top5_off AS "Excess vs Top5 %"
FROM raw r
JOIN sess_off o ON o.session_id = r.session_id
ORDER BY 1;

spec.title: 6. Cumulative across sessions — Portfolio value (M IRT)
spec.description: All selected sessions on real wall-clock. Each day’s path is shifted by the sum of earlier sessions’ end port/index/excess % (vs each session’s own prior close), so the series is a continuous additive cumulative from the first selected session. Only rows with local clock time 12:00–18:00 (Asia/Tehran) are included (pre-open snapshots excluded).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT p.ts AS time,
       p.portfolio_value / 1e7 AS "Portfolio M IRT"
FROM pair_trade.portfolio_snapshot p
WHERE p.session_id IN ($session)
  AND ((p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time >= TIME '12:00:00' AND (p.ts AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tehran')::time <= TIME '18:00:00')
ORDER BY 1;
